_doc: Shot manifest for npm run stills and compare (spec section 13). Per shot: name, wait ('jardin' = window.__jardin.ready, 'dom' = DOM ready only), mode (forced ?mode, omit for the app's own), viewport [w,h], t (frozen content time, seconds), refs (reference ids to compare against, first is the pairing default). World builders override hash, pose, t and viewport in content/garden.json under 'shots' (ARCH 2.9, GardenLayout.shots); a shot there with a 'visitor' [x, z] is a free roam shot (the visitor stands there; every other shot keeps the rail world); garden.json wins over this file, this file fills what garden.json does not say.
